model: white-label AI launch production for agencies
summary: Agencies DO buy outside AI production and ARE short of hours, but they buy it as labour (open budgets, R$50 platform minimums, 13-62 proposals per post, R$1.500/month for ~120 simple edits), they already own the tools (Creative Cloud Pro para equipes R$383,95-480/licence, Firefly Pro para equipes R$95/licence with Nano Banana 2 'gerações ilimitadas'), and AI studios already court them at published prices (ANIMAI 'Equipes e agências… parceira de produção', R$70/image, R$15/s video). White label re-routes a SUBSET of the same ~300-brand launch pool at a LOWER price, and each order still costs her 5-12 h, so by the archive's own test it is a job, not the wholesale escape. Standalone: DEAD. As a second leg of the direct O LANÇAMENTO (agency rate card, produtora-parceira pass-through seat, packaging/branding agencies that hold the artwork before launch): MARGINAL.

population.count: ALL agencies (IBGE CEMPRE 2024, table 9528): CNAE 73.11-4 'Agências de publicidade' = 28.542 local units in Brazil (73.106 persons ⇒ 2,6/unit), 10.254 in São Paulo state, 5.974 in São Paulo city (21.506 persons ⇒ 3,6/unit); plus 73.19-0 'outras atividades de publicidade' 138.319 units in Brazil / 27.557 in SP city. CENP-certified full-service agencies: 1.090 in Brazil, 481 in the Sudeste (01/09/2026). ABRE (packaging association): 274 members, ~15 of them packaging-design agencies (Tátil, Narita, Team Créatif, Mind the Pack, Mudrá, Quadrante, Sapien, Spice, Obah, Bendito, Brainbox, Dudi, A10, 100% Design, Zoom Mais). BEAUTY-SPECIALIST agencies found by name in one search pass: ~10 (Let's Flow Digital [Natalia Beauty + Grupo Duo&Co], Beauty Marketing, Cavalini, Carcará [Brasília], Five Performance, The BeClub, Beauty Co, Vejjo, ThinkLab [consultancy], plus Target Design / Kombi on packaging); of these ~6 serve product BRANDS rather than salons/clinics. Agencies with ≥1 beauty product-brand client: NOT COUNTABLE from any source reached (UNVERIFIED). The ONE 'agência' in the ANVISA holder file, '+ BRIEFING AGENCIA DE PUBLICIDADE E REPRESENTACOES LTDA' (~998 brand keys), is a cosmetics FACTORY (CNPJ 21.566.221/0001-00, primary CNAE 2063-1/00, ME, capital R$200.000, Guarapari/ES, trade name 'SUPORTT PROJETOS EXCLUSIVOS') — factory-as-agency, i.e. the W2 free-front-door finding again, not a channel.
population.method: IBGE SIDRA API (servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/agregados/9528, 2024; 6450 for 2021 cross-check: 12.881 units of 73.11-4 in 2021 → 28.542 in 2024); CENP certification page; ABRE members page parsed; WebSearch + direct fetch of specialist agency sites; ANVISA TA_CONSULTA_COSMETICOS.CSV holder grep + publica.cnpj.ws. Agency COUNT is not the binding number — the binding number is launch EVENTS that pass through an agency and get outsourced.
population.needed: At a realistic wholesale R$1.500-2.000 per one-product set: 6,1-10,5 orders/month (gross R$12.218-15.806 needed, fator-r 9,1-9,4%, stack R$750-1.379) = 73-126 a year. Orders per agency (UNVERIFIED): beauty-specialist with 5-15 launching brand clients × 3 windows/yr (H6A median) × 50% sent out = 0,6-1,9/month; generalist with 1-3 beauty clients = 0,1-0,4/month. ⇒ 3-18 specialist accounts or 15-100 generalist accounts; realistic mix 8-20 active agencies — against ~6 specialists identified by name.
population.pool_div4: Pool = ~300 own-brand launchers (225-425) × 2-3 launch windows/yr × P(brand uses an agency for launch creative) × P(agency outsources production) × wholesale price. Central: 300×2-3×0,45×0,40 = 108-162 events × R$1.750 = R$189-284k/yr ⇒ pool÷4 = R$47-71k against R$147-190k/yr needed ⇒ required share 52-100%: FAILS the market-multiple rule by 2-4×. Low corner (225×1×0,3×0,3 × R$1.500) R$30k ⇒ ÷4 R$7,6k. High corner (425×4×0,6×0,5 × R$2.000) R$1,02M ⇒ ÷4 R$255k: passes only here. Five stacked multipliers, the two agency ones fully unmeasured ⇒ a hypothesis, not a number. NOTE: because the direct plan excludes brands with an entrenched agency, this pool is COMPLEMENTARY to the direct pool (the agency-served segment), not the same brands twice — it can add to direct, it cannot replace it.

free_front_door: STRONGER than for the direct version, because agencies are the tool vendor's own customer. (1) THE TOOLS ARE ALREADY ON THEIR DESKS: Adobe BR 'Creative Cloud Pro para equipes… Regularmente em R$480,00/mês Ou a R$383,95/mês por licença… além da IA criativa do Adobe Firefly'; 'Firefly Pro para equipes R$95,00/mês por licença' with 'Acesso aos principais modelos de IA da Adobe, do Google e muito mais' and 'Gerações ilimitadas em modelos selecionados, incluindo Nano Banana 2 (1K), Flux.2 Pro… no primeiro ano' (adobe.com/br/products/firefly/plans.html, fetched). CENP's own site carries Adobe-sponsored content selling AI production to agencies ('Como reduzir o tempo de produção com inteligência artificial', 24 Aug). Compositing a real packshot into a generated scene is ordinary Photoshop work for an agency designer — the 'fidelity by construction' method is a native agency skill, not a secret (Adobe Harmonize page, per H6D). (2) AGENCIES ALREADY SELL AI PRODUCTION THEMSELVES: Carcará (cosmetics-industry agency) lists 'Fotografia publicitária criada com IA'; Beauty Marketing lists 'Fotografia', 'Mockups', 'Campanha' in-house; packaging agency Kombi delivers 'Simulações realistas de mockups… como sua embalagem ficará no ponto de venda' inside the packaging job — the label-exact pre-launch visual is BUNDLED. (3) AI STUDIOS ALREADY COURT AGENCIES AT PUBLISHED PRICES: ANIMAI R$70/image, R$15/s video, 'Equipes e agências'; Nobreak R$597-1.797/month incl. 'Geração de Imagens IA', 'agências… confiam em nós'; eDesign Criação 'Suporte Criativo White Label para agências… CGI & 3D, Motion Graphics' (no price); Composer Invent AI video 'para empresas, marcas e agências'. Orne (R$5,50-6,90/image, 'Fidelidade total ao produto' as a bullet) has no agency programme text; Villo and Estúdio Fábrica none either. (4) What label-exact compositing + claim lock + 5-7 days adds that an agency cannot get cheaper: only (a) label-locked MOTION — a 15 s film whose label does not warp — which static/Canva agency designers do not produce quickly and which the 99Freelas agency posts show they outsource; (b) a written fidelity guarantee with remake at her cost; (c) peak capacity on a 5-day clock. Static composited stills: nothing — that is their own designer's afternoon.

price_and_hours.wholesale_price: Evidence brackets it at R$1.100-2.300 per one-product set. FLOOR: what agencies can already buy — ANIMAI list ≈R$1.100-1.150 for the set-equivalent; Orne ≈R$280-360; labour posts at R$11-14/edited video. CEILING: the direct price the brand would pay (R$2.500-3.500, AUD3) less the agency's cut. If she takes the PASS-THROUGH seat of the Normas-Padrão (agency 'remunerada pelo cliente no percentual de 15% sobre o valor dos serviços… contratados com esses mesmos fornecedores', Sinapro list quoting CENP 3.11.2) her price can be R$2.290-2.490 and the client pays R$2.630-2.860 (< her R$2.990 direct: no channel conflict). In the WHITE-LABEL seat small agencies price outsourcing as labour and keep the spread: realistic R$1.200-1.800 (UNVERIFIED — no agency quoted a number for this product). Narrower product that best survives: label-locked 15 s film + 2 cutdowns from the agency's approved packshot/KV at R$1.290 (≈5-6× ANIMAI's R$225 list for 15 s, justified only by the label lock + guarantee; UNVERIFIED).
price_and_hours.hours_per_order: Production (AUD3/H6D, estimates, no stopwatch): start 9,5-18 h; mature 6-10 h; re-specced grammar 4-6 h per one-product set; film-only 3-5 h. PLUS agency layer 1-2 h per order (agency brief, two-layer approval agency→client, relayed revisions; UNVERIFIED). ⇒ 7-12 h mature, 5-8 h re-specced, 4-6 h film-only. Account management 2-4 h/month per active agency in Portuguese calls/WhatsApp (UNVERIFIED). Acquisition 10-20 h per agency won (20-30 calls + 2-3 free test pieces + onboarding/NDA; UNVERIFIED), ~0,5-1 agency/month in year 1. THE ARCHIVE'S WHITE-LABEL TEST FAILS: each of the partner's marginal orders costs her 5-12 h, so this is 'a job, not the wholesale escape' (CLAUDE.md, THE WHOLESALE ESCAPE DOES NOT TRANSPOSE…).
price_and_hours.accounts_needed: 3-18 beauty-specialist agencies at 0,6-1,9 orders/agency/month, or 15-100 generalists at 0,1-0,4; realistic 8-20 active accounts. Only ~6 beauty-product-brand specialists were identified by name; ABRE has ~15 packaging-design agencies (mostly big-brand accounts). The account count is not obviously smaller than the direct model's ~25-30 brands, and each account is heavier (NDA, two-layer approvals, pay-when-paid).
price_and_hours.fits_87h: ONLY IF wholesale ≥ ~R$2.000 AND production is re-specced to ≤5-6,5 h per order including the agency layer. Central estimates: R$1.500 mature (9,3 orders × 9,5 h + 8 accounts × 3 h + 15 h acquisition) ≈ 128 h — DOES NOT FIT; R$2.000 mature ≈ 100 h — does not fit; R$2.290 mature ≈ 88 h — edge; R$2.000 re-specced (6,5 h) ≈ 79 h — fits; film-only R$1.290 at 5 h with 8 accounts ≈ 93 h — does not fit. At the labour-rate prices agencies actually post, it never fits.

risks: (1) CASH CYCLE — pay-when-paid is the contractual norm: a public agency contract (Heads Propaganda / Paraná, 2024) says 'Os pagamentos a fornecedores… serão efetuados pela CONTRATADA em até 5 (cinco) dias úteis após o recebimento da ordem bancária do CONTRATANTE', and the agency itself has up to 90 days after veiculação to invoice (cl. 13.1). The Sinapro norms note: the client pays agency fees at sight 'prevalecendo, porém, o prazo de vencimento das faturas de serviços de terceiros' — i.e. the SUPPLIER's own terms govern, so 50% on order is defensible, but small agencies will push 30-60 days or pay-when-paid (UNVERIFIED for private small agencies). With R$15.600 of one-time capital and ~91-94% gross margin the exposure is receivables risk, not float — cap open receivables per agency at 2 orders. (2) PRICE SQUEEZE — the agency keeps the spread and benchmarks her against ANIMAI (R$70/image), Nobreak (R$1.797/month unlimited) and 13-62 freelance proposals per post; every agency post seen asks for unit prices or 'valores acessíveis'. (3) CONFIDENTIALITY / NO PORTFOLIO — white-label posts require no client contact ('sem contato direto com os clientes', 'sempre feito pela agência'); she cannot show the work, which starves her own acquisition (C2 already forbids a public portfolio; a private one needs the agency's permission). Pre-launch artwork arrives from a third party → must never go to a generator that trains on inputs (O LANÇAMENTO Part C §2). (4) DISPUTES LAND ON HER BLIND — the end client's objections arrive relayed and distorted through the agency, revisions multiply across two approval layers, and she cannot talk to the person deciding; liability does not disappear (CDC art. 67 reaches whoever 'faz' the ad; CBAP names the creation chain) — so the claim lock must be the AGENCY's written approval of every claim and visual, contractually. (5) CHANNEL CONFLICT / NON-SOLICIT — agencies will demand she never sell direct to their clients; incompatible with a direct O LANÇAMENTO outbound to the same ANVISA launch list unless the agency-served brands are carved out. (6) TREADMILL — agencies are the most tool-literate buyers and Adobe is actively selling them the capability; this segment goes 'obsolete' first (self-serve product-lock estimated 12-18 months, H6D).
vs_direct: WORSE on price, pool and treadmill; BETTER only on origination. Direct: R$2.990, 4,1-5,3 kits/month, ~25-30 active brands, honest floor US$700-1.500/month (AUD3/O_LANCAMENTO). White label: R$1.200-2.300, 5,3-13,2 orders/month, 8-20 active agencies, honest floor US$500-1.100/month (3-4 orders at R$1.500-1.750 ⇒ R$2.700-5.614 net ⇒ US$521-1.084; US$0 if the test fails). Pool÷4 central R$47-71k vs direct's R$148,5k (AUD3, P=33% central). What it TRADES: it keeps ORIGINATION-ONCE per agency (a signed agency sends several launches without new outbound) and it reaches the agency-served brands the direct plan excludes; it trades away price (−25 to −60%), the MACHINE TEST (5-12 h of her hands per order, and a relationship she must hold), portfolio rights, and cash-cycle control. As a replacement: no. As a second leg on top of direct: yes, if the test clears.

candidate.name: O LANÇAMENTO — TABELA AGÊNCIA (produtora parceira, not white label)
candidate.offer: A second channel for the direct O LANÇAMENTO. To beauty-specialist, branding and packaging-design agencies (the ones holding the brand AT the pre-launch moment WITH the approved artwork): (a) the one-product label-locked launch set at an agency rate of R$2.290 (vs R$2.990 direct), invoiced by her as a named third-party supplier so the agency adds its 15% Normas-Padrão honorários and the client pays ≈R$2.630 — below the direct price; or (b) O FILME: a label-locked 15 s film + 2 cutdowns built from the agency's own approved packshot/mockup render, R$1.290, 5 business days, written guarantee ('todo caractere da embalagem idêntico à arte aprovada ou refazemos sem custo'), NDA, no end-client contact, 50% on order / 50% on delivery by Pix against nota fiscal, claims and visuals approved in writing by the agency. Packaging agencies already make the label-exact mockup render from artwork (Kombi 'simulações realistas de mockups'); she supplies the campaign world and the motion they do not make — complementary halves, and it solves VER1's finding that 0 of 15 genuinely new SKUs had a public packshot when the ANVISA signal fired.
candidate.biggest_flaw: Agencies buy outside production as LABOUR at labour prices (open budgets, R$50 minimums, R$1.500/month for ~120 edits, 13-62 proposals per post) and already hold the tools (Creative Cloud Pro para equipes R$383,95-480; Firefly Pro para equipes R$95 with Nano Banana 2) and cheap AI studios (ANIMAI R$70/image); each order still costs her 5-12 h, so it is a job, not the wholesale escape — and the agency-mediated launch pool clears only 25-50% of the market-multiple bar centrally.
candidate.repair: (1) Sell only what an agency designer cannot do by Friday: label-locked MOTION with a written remake guarantee, priced per film, never per hour or per image. (2) Take the pass-through supplier seat (CENP 15%), not the white-label discount seat; target the ~6 beauty-product specialists + ~15 ABRE packaging-design agencies + CENP Sudeste agencies with a cosmetics client, not SME social-media shops. (3) Supplier terms govern (Sinapro note 10): 50% on order, refuse pay-when-paid, cap receivables at 2 open orders per agency. (4) Carve agency-served brands out of the direct ANVISA outbound list to avoid non-solicit conflict. (5) Keep it a SECOND LEG; never let it replace direct pricing.
candidate.honest_floor_usd_month: As a standalone white-label business: US$500-1.100/month at months 12-18 (3-4 orders at R$1.500-1.750); US$0 if the test fails. As a second leg on top of direct O LANÇAMENTO: adds ≈US$250-700/month (1-3 agency orders at R$1.290-2.290).
candidate.next_test: R$0, Portuguese calls, 2 weeks: call 20 agencies — 10 beauty-specialist/branding/packaging-design agencies with a named beauty PRODUCT client (Beauty Marketing, Cavalini, Let's Flow, Five Performance, Target Design, Kombi, Tátil, Narita, Team Créatif, Mind the Pack …) + 10 CENP-certified Sudeste agencies whose portfolio shows a cosmetics client. Three questions, no pitch first: (a) 'No último lançamento de produto de um cliente de beleza, quem produziu as imagens e o filme, e quanto a agência pagou a esse fornecedor?' (b) 'Vocês compraram produção com IA de fora nos últimos 6 meses? De quem, a que preço?' (c) 'Qual o prazo de pagamento que vocês praticam com fornecedores de produção?' Then offer ONE paid pilot: O FILME at R$1.290 on a current client packshot.
candidate.bar: Committed in advance. ALIVE as a second leg if ≥5/20 name an EXTERNAL production spend ≥R$2.000 for a one-product launch AND ≥2/20 buy the R$1.290 pilot within 30 days AND ≤half name pay-when-paid or >30-day terms. DEAD (stop, do not discount) if ≤2/20 name ≥R$2.000 external spend — the agency channel is then capped at ANIMAI's ≈R$1.100 set-equivalent, where the arithmetic needs 11-14 orders/month and does not fit 87 h.

verdict_note: DEAD as the tested model (white label REPLACING the direct kit): it fails THE WHOLESALE ESCAPE test (5-12 h of her hands per partner order), the market-multiple rule (central pool÷4 R$47-71k vs R$147-190k needed), the free front door is stronger at agencies than at brands (tools on their desks, AI studios courting them at R$70/image), and the only agency money observed is at labour rates. The REPAIRED form — an agency rate card / produtora-parceira pass-through seat with O FILME as the entry product, run as a SECOND LEG of the direct O LANÇAMENTO — is MARGINAL pending the 20-call test.
